areas: Annapolis, Baltimore, Washington, D.C., Northern Virginia

hero.eyebrow: Projects featured in Architectural Digest and Annapolis Home Magazine
hero.sub: Scenes, schedules, and every light in the house from a keypad, an app, or your voice.

items.p: One button sets the whole room. Scenes for mornings, entertaining, relaxing, and bedtime.
Lights follow your schedule. Motorized shades and the rest of the house can move with them.
Lit walkways, driveways, and entries. Lights that keep running while you travel.

steps.p: We settle the layout, where each fixture goes, and how every space is controlled.
A lighting plan on paper before fixtures, wiring, and ceilings are final.
Every run and every load listed, so your electrician pulls it once.
Installed, programmed, and tested, then tuned once the home is lived in.

photos.alt: A living room with wall lights, shelf lighting, and shades
Hanging glass lights lit in a stairwell at dusk
A double-height lounge with long hanging lights under a beamed ceiling

about.p: Performance Home Automation designs and installs lighting control for new construction, renovations, and existing homes. One team takes it from the first design through installation, programming, testing, and support.
about.alt: Seven of the Performance Home Automation team in company shirts at a trade show

items.p: PHA was fabulous during my home renovation. We automated Lutron lighting throughout the house, built in sonos speakers and security cameras, all operated from the phone. They are reliable, reasonable and professional.
We have been working with PHA for almost six years on various home electronics projects and couldn't recommend them more.
Fantastic job getting my home AV set up with all the accoutrements. Very friendly, efficient and priced well. Very pleased.

final.p: Tell us about your home and pick a time.
